title: The Quartermaster's Ledger
location: Club 1127 (Y=-200) and the freight pipeline up to the Spaceport
summary: A big ship shot you down six months ago. Big ships don't dogfight — they collect. Vesper knows whose ledger flagged you for collection, and the ledger rides the freight pipe twice a year. The next run is soon.
_hooks: The Quartermaster heist (STORYLINE_EXPANSIONS (a)). give-gated on harvest.known (Emily's reveal) + club.found (Vesper). Vesper opens the thread via a NEW act2_quartermaster tree appended to her file (authored in chat_trees/club1127_vesper_act2.json). The ledger item + harvest.predated reveal seed Act-4 Human Collaborators and the high-karma 'collaborator trials' ending overlay (f1 LANTERNS) — registered into the evidence package alongside Aria's manifest + Reyes's batch records. Uses the engine's existing descent-tube/freight-line space (per the expansion doc). The Quartermaster himself surfaces in person at the Spaceport — see act2_storm_runner.
_voice: He is never a boss in Act 2 — 'a ledger, a cologne, an empty barstool.' The horror is bureaucratic: you were a purchase order. Vesper prices the rumor; she never lies.

stages.objective: Buy the thread from Vesper. Bring her something she doesn't already know.
The ledger physically rides the freight pipe. Find where the next run loads.
Get aboard the freight line without tripping the manifest check. Loud or quiet — both have a bill.
Find the ledger. It's a physical book, because the man who keeps it doesn't trust networks any more than you do.
The line's awake now. Fight to the ledger and out before the run seals.

args.text: Quiet was the cheaper option. This is the other one.

stages.objective: Read what the ledger says about you. The entry is dated. Check when.
The order was cut before your flight plan was filed. He didn't find your ship. He found your bloodwork. Keep the book — it's evidence now.
